reason: We have to replace lost volume and my two or three salespeople only farm existing accounts, so I need meetings from outside the network. The free 15-company list shows me whether they understand freight before I risk anything, and with 3 free meetings and a EUR 1,800 cap the downside is small next to one new lane contract.
objection: Do they actually understand 3PL and forwarding, or will they book me calls with people who just want a cheaper rate quote and no switching intent? One logistics client with 45 meetings tells me nothing about how many turned into signed volume.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15-company list in step 1 is generic, with companies that already have locked-in forwarders or are too small to move volume, I stop there and do not start the pilot.
